opening.speaker: Ogma
opening.text: Prince Marth! I am Ogma, captain of the mercenaries sent by King Mostyn of Talys. Joining me are three skilled axe fighters: Barst, Bord, and Cord.

opening.speaker: Marth
opening.text: Having you and the Talys warriors at our side is worth ten thousand soldiers. What is the situation at the port of Galder, Ogma?

opening.speaker: Ogma
opening.text: Galder has fallen into the hands of Gomer's pirate horde, dividing the terrain with deep waters and treacherous bridges. What is worse, Grustian cavaliers patrol the area searching for you. We must proceed with extreme caution!

opening.speaker: Marth
opening.text: Understood. Keep our formation tight across the narrow bridges and advance on Gomer's stronghold!

recruit_castor.speaker: Caeda
recruit_castor.text: Castor?! Is that you over there, Castor the hunter from Talys?!

recruit_castor.speaker: Castor
recruit_castor.text: Ah... Princess Caeda?! Princess... please, do not look at me with such eyes...

recruit_castor.speaker: Caeda
recruit_castor.text: Why is an honest man like you taking up a bow for these merciless pirates? Did something happen to you?

recruit_castor.speaker: Castor
recruit_castor.text: My mother... she is bedridden with a grave illness. We are desperately poor, and I had no money for her medicine, so I was driven to take their coin... I am ashamed to call myself a man!

recruit_castor.speaker: Caeda
recruit_castor.text: It was out of devotion to your mother... Castor, take this gold to buy medicine and care for her. Never consort with thieves again. Join Prince Marth's ranks and fight with us for justice!

recruit_castor.speaker: Castor
recruit_castor.text: Princess... your mercy knows no bounds! You have saved my mother's life. From this moment onward, my bow and my life belong to you and Prince Marth!

village_galder.speaker: Galder Elder
village_galder.text: Hail Prince Marth and the Altean army! You have liberated our port from the clutches of the pirates!

village_galder.speaker: Galder Elder
village_galder.text: Our village has gathered 3,000 gold as a gift for your army. A word of warning: the path ahead leads through the Devil Mountain, the dreaded stronghold of the Samsoian bandits.

village_galder.speaker: Galder Elder
village_galder.text: Most perilous of all is the mercenary swordsman Navarre. His blade cuts with lethal precision, and no one has ever survived his strike. Please, my prince, take utmost care!

boss_gomer.startCombat: You vermin dare meddle in Gomer's business? See how my throwing axe takes your heads one by one!
boss_gomer.death: Inconceivable... The master of Galder... felled here...!

ending.speaker: Marth
ending.text: The port of Galder is liberated! I thank every warrior for their courage and sacrifice.

ending.speaker: Jagen
ending.text: Sire, this victory will inspire all who hear of it. But ahead lies the treacherous pass of Devil Mountain, teeming with ambushes before we can reach Duke Hardin in Aurelis.

ending.speaker: Marth
ending.text: Though our path be perilous, we shall not waver. Form up our lines, everyone—we enter Devil Mountain!
